description: The image illustrates five distinct distribution patterns or shape profiles using a series of five small, adjacent bar charts. The horizontal axis serves as the category axis, displaying five distinct labels below individual baselines: "Increasing", "Uniform", "Decreasing", "Spindle", and "Bottleneck". There is no vertical value axis, scale, tick marks, or units provided, meaning the heights of the bars represent relative, unspecified values. Above each label, a group of four adjacent, unlabeled bars is displayed, all colored in a uniform muted grayish-green with black outlines. In the "Increasing" group, the four bars progressively increase in height from left to right, with the shortest bar on the far left and the tallest on the far right. The "Uniform" group consists of four bars of identical height. The "Decreasing" group shows four bars progressively decreasing in height from left to right, starting with the tallest and ending with the shortest. The "Spindle" group features two short outer bars of equal height and two tall inner bars of equal height. Conversely, the "Bottleneck" group displays two tall outer bars of equal height and two short inner bars of equal height. The arrangement of bar heights within each group directly corresponds to the descriptive label below it, and no individual bars are visually emphasized over others.
